actions.reason: K5_C0001 has a substantively interpretable biological identity: coordinated OXPHOS down-regulation with TGF-beta/WNT up-regulation (RNA) and a globally robust PBRM1-enriched mutation profile (q_global 0.0036). Its boundary with K5_C0004 is positively supported: independent spectral ARI 1.0, within-side affinity 0.431 vs between-side 0.108, low normalized-cut cost 0.401, and a two-cluster union resolution (candidate_k=2) indicating the union subdivides rather than collapsing. No candidate-specific technical factor survives correction (all q>=0.072). Membership representation is mixed (only WSI positive), but the affirmative K5_C0001-K5_C0004 boundary evidence establishes independence, and no supported split or merge rescue is available.

K5_C0002 has a coherent biological identity: strong OXPHOS up-regulation with fatty-acid/mTORC1 programs (RNA) and a globally robust VHL-depleted mutation profile (q_global 3.07e-07), directionally distinct from K5_C0001. Its boundary with K5_C0003 is positively represented: independent spectral ARI 0.920, within-side affinity 0.450 vs between-side 0.151, moderate normalized-cut cost 0.506. Although several CT/site factors are associated with K5_C0002 membership, the partition-wide confounder concern is not candidate-specific proof of artifact, and the represented boundary plus distinct biology support retention. No supported split or merge rescue is available.

K5_C0003 has a coherent immune/inflammatory transcriptomic phenotype (allograft rejection, interferon responses) and a globally robust BAP1-enriched mutation profile (q_global 0.0180), distinct from the VHL/PBRM1 patterns of K5_C0001 and K5_C0002. Its boundary with K5_C0004 is positively supported: independent spectral ARI 0.871, within-side affinity 0.629 vs between-side 0.131, low normalized-cut cost 0.364, with a two-cluster union resolution. Membership representation is mixed (RNA/CT weakly positive, WSI/WXS negative), but the affirmative K5_C0003-K5_C0004 boundary evidence establishes independence. No supported split or merge rescue is available.

K5_C0004 has a coherent mesenchymal/stromal transcriptomic phenotype (EMT, Hedgehog, angiogenesis) and a directionally coherent ccRCC mutation profile (VHL enriched 14/14, PBRM1 depleted, surviving within-driver-panel FDR). Its boundaries with K5_C0001 and K5_C0003 are both positively supported by independent spectral ARI (1.0 and 0.871), clear within-vs-between affinity contrast, low normalized-cut costs, and two-cluster union resolutions. No candidate-specific technical factor survives correction. Membership representation is mixed (WXS degenerate-perfect, others negative), but the affirmative boundary evidence establishes independence. No supported split or merge rescue is available.

K5_C0005 (n=4) has a proliferative RNA phenotype but its WXS mutation profile is sparse and not robustly distinguishable (all q_driver>=0.279, all q_global=1.0), and its membership is broadly unsupported: only WXS shows positive representation while CT, RNA, and WSI are negative. Its boundaries are weak or conflicting: K5_C0001-K5_C0005 has near-zero independent spectral ARI (0.044), high normalized-cut cost 0.904, and single-cluster-dominated union; K5_C0002-K5_C0005 has ARI -0.015 and high cost 0.803; K5_C0003-K5_C0005 has high cost 0.818 with single-cluster-dominated union. No candidate-specific technical factor survives correction, and no supported split or merge rescue is available. The very small size further limits any defensible independent discovery-stage unit.
